items.title: 6.1 Gases ke kinetic theory ke mafrooze (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.1 with Figs. 6.1 to 6.3, Example 6.1 and thermal equilibrium (PDF 119-124).

blocks.text: Thermodynamics physics ki woh shakh hai jo garmi (heat) aur energy ki doosri shakalon ke darmiyan taalluqat aur tabdeeliyon se nimatti hai. Yeh bare paimane (macroscopic) par systems ke rawayye ke usool, jaise temperature, dabao aur volume, shamil karti hai. Yun thermodynamics technology mein aham kirdar ada karti hai, kyunke hamare istemal ki taqreeban sari khaam energy garmi ki shakal mein azaad hoti hai. Is chapter mein hum gases ka rawayya aur thermodynamics ke qawaneen, un ki ahmiyat aur istemalat parhte hain.

Gases ka kinetic theory physics aur chemistry ka bunyadi nazriya hai jo gases ke rawayye ki wazahat un ke zarraat ki harkat ki bunyad par karta hai; yeh dabao, temperature aur volume jaisi gas ki khusoosiyat ki macroscopic samajh deta hai. Us ke bunyadi mafrooze (assumptions) yeh hain:

items: Gas ke zarre mustaqil, be-tarteeb harkat mein hain: gas ke molecules hamesha be-tarteeb harkat mein hain, seedhi lakeeron mein chalte hue jab tak kisi aur molecule ya bartan ki deewaron se na takrayein.
Gas ke zarron ka volume na-qabil-e-zikr hai: alag alag molecules ka volume gas ke kul volume ke muqable na-qabil-e-zikr hai, to zarre baghair kisi aham volume ke nuqtai masses mane jate hain.
Koi intermolecular forces nahi: gas ke molecules ke darmiyan koi kashish ya dafa ki forces nahi; zarre takrao ke siwa ek doosre par koi force nahi lagate.

Elastic takrao: gas ke molecules ke darmiyan, aur molecules aur bartan ki deewaron ke darmiyan takrao bilkul elastic hain, to takrao ke doran kinetic energy ka koi khalis nuqsan nahi; kul kinetic energy baqi rehti hai.
Zarron ki bari tadaad: gas mein zarron ki bari tadaad hoti hai, jo us ki khusoosiyat bayan karne ko shumariyati (statistical) tareeqe istemal karne deti hai.

Ausat kinetic energy temperature ke tanasub mein hai: gas ke zarron ki ausat kinetic energy gas ke mutlaq temperature ke seedhe tanasub mein hai, to temperature barhne par zarron ki speed bhi barhti hai.
Dabao zarron ke takrao se: bartan ki deewaron par gas ka dabao deewaron se gas ke zarron ke takrao ki wajah se hai; takrao mein lagai force dabao paida karti hai.
Takrao ka waqt na-qabil-e-zikr hai: gas ke zarron ke takrao mein lagne wala waqt takrao ke darmiyani waqt ke muqable intehai kam hai, jo zarron ki harkat ka tajziya saada karta hai.

blocks.text: Real gases: kinetic theory ke mafrooze ideal gases ke liye durust hain, magar real gases intermolecular forces aur mahdood molecular volume ki wajah se, khaas kar zyada dabao aur kam temperature par, inhiraf dikhati hain. Khulasa yeh ke kinetic theory gas ke rawayye ki macroscopic tasveer deti hai, dabao aur temperature jaisi macroscopic khusoosiyat ko gas ke zarron ki harkat se jorti hai, aur thermodynamics aur statistical mechanics samajhne mein bunyadi tasawwur ka kaam karti hai.
Ideal gas ke liye equation of state

blocks.title: Ideal gas equation
blocks.text: Jo gas kinetic theory par chale use ideal gas kehte hain. Ideal gas equation PV = nRT ... (6.1) hai, jahan P dabao, V volume, n gas ke moles ki tadaad, R universal gas constant (R = 8.3145 J mol^-1 K^-1) aur T temperature hai. Equation 6.1 ka matlab hai ke ideal gas ke liye dabao aur volume ka hasil-e-zarb temperature ke seedhe tanasub mein hai.
Real gas ka ideal gas jaisa rawayya

Kinetic theory ke mutabiq gas mein koi intermolecular tasur nahi aur us ke molecules ek doosre se door hain; real gas ke ideal gas jaisa rawayya dikhane ke liye kuch sharait poori honi chahiye: gas ke molecules ki PE na-qabil-e-zikr ho aur un ke paas sirf KE ho. Eq. 6.1 mein n = gas ka mass / gas ka molar mass = m/M, to Eq. 6.1 ban jati hai PV = (m/M) RT, ya PM = (m/V) RT. Chunke density rho = m/V, rho = PM/(RT), ya rho P/T ke tanasub mein kyunke M/R mustaqil hai. Kam dabao aur zyada temperature par gas ki density kam hogi, to molecules ek doosre se bare faaslon par honge aur intermolecular forces na-qabil-e-zikr. Yun real gas kam dabao aur zyada temperature par ideal gas jaisa rawayya dikhati hai (For Your Information).
Boltzmann constant ke zariye ideal gas equation

Ideal gas equation PV = nRT ... (i) se, n ideal gas ke moles ki tadaad hai, jo fi unit Avogadro's number (N_A = 6.02 x 10^23) atoms ya molecules ki tadaad ke taur par bayan hoti hai: n = N / N_A ... (ii). (ii) ko (i) mein rakhne par PV = (N/N_A) RT ... (iii). Term R/N_A Boltzmann constant k_B hai: k_B = R/N_A ... (6.2); R aur N_A ki qeematein rakhne par k_B = 1.38 x 10^-23 J K^-1. Eq. 6.2 ko (iii) mein rakhne par PV = N k_B T ... (6.3), Boltzmann constant ke zariye ideal gas equation.

blocks.title: Example 6.1
blocks.text: Ideal gas ka ek mole 300 K temperature par hai. Agar Boltzmann constant 1.38 x 10^-23 J K^-1 ho to 1 atm (1 atm = 101 325 Pa) dabao par gas ka volume nikalein. Hal: PV = nRT, R = N_A x k_B ke saath, to V = n x N_A x k_B x T / P = 1 mol x 6.02 x 10^23 mol^-1 x 1.38 x 10^-23 J K^-1 x 300 K / 101 325 Pa = 0.03 m^3 (jaisa chhapa; hasil-e-zarb 0.0246 m^3 nikalta hai). Yun gas ka volume 0.03 m^3 hoga.

Kuch variables (state functions) gas ki miqdar bayan karte hain: dabao, volume aur temperature (P, V aur T). Ek variable badalne par doosra badalta hai jabke teesra mustaqil rakha jata hai; ideal gas ke liye in variables ko aapas mein jorne wale qawaneen gas ke qawaneen hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Mustaqil temperature par jab volume V barhta hai to dabao P ghatta hai, is liye curve neeche aata hai. Curve ke har nuqte par P zarb V barabar hai: P1 V1 = P2 V2. Aisa curve hyperbola kehlata hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is graph mein temperature degree Celsius mein hai. Lakeer ko peeche barhayein to -273 °C par volume sifar ho jata hai; yahi mutlaq sifar (absolute zero, 0 K) hai. Kelvin mein naapein to lakeer origin se guzarti hai, yani V T ke seedhe tanasub (direct proportion) mein hai.

blocks.title: Thermal equilibrium
blocks.text: Jab do ajsam ek hi temperature par hon to har jism ki thermal energy (jo zarron ki kinetic energy se juri hai) barabar hoti hai; nateejatan un ke darmiyan heat ki muntaqili ki koi mohrik force nahi, aur woh thermal equilibrium mein rehte hain. Misal: jab dhaat ka chamcha garam coffee ke cup mein dala jaye, shuru mein coffee chamche se zyada garam hoti hai; waqt ke saath heat coffee se chamche mein bahti hai; aakhir coffee aur chamcha ek hi temperature par pohnchte hain. Is nuqte par thermal equilibrium hasil hoti hai: un ke darmiyan koi khalis heat flow nahi.

blocks.prompt: 25.0 L ke bartan mein 300 K par anjaan gas ka 2.5 g namoona 8.21 atm dabao rakhta hai; us ka molar mass nikalein. Gas 20 degrees C par 400 mL leti hai; mustaqil dabao par 80 degrees C par kitna volume? 2 atm aur 300 K par gas: mustaqil volume par 450 K par kya dabao (numerical 6.1, 6.7, 6.8)?
blocks.explanation: R = 0.0821 L atm mol^-1 K^-1 ke saath n = 8.21 x 25.0 / (0.0821 x 300) = 8.33 mol, jo 2.5 g ke saath 0.3 g mol^-1 deta hai; chhapa jawab 37.6 g mol^-1 0.0821 atm dabao ya 313 g mass ke mutabiq hai. Charles: V2 = V1 T2/T1 = 400 x 353/293 = 482 mL. Gay-Lussac: P2 = P1 T2/T1 = 2 x 450/300 = 3 atm.

items: Kinetic theory: be-tarteeb seedhi harkat, na-qabil-e-zikr volume, koi intermolecular forces nahi, elastic takrao, bohat se zarre, ausat KE T ke tanasub mein, deewaron se takrao se dabao, takrao ka waqt na-qabil-e-zikr; real gases zyada P aur kam T par inhiraf karti hain.

Ideal gas: PV = nRT (R = 8.3145 J mol^-1 K^-1); rho = PM/RT; PV = N k_B T, k_B = R/N_A = 1.38 x 10^-23 J K^-1. Boyle PV = const (T), Charles V/T = const (P), Gay-Lussac P/T = const (V). Thermal equilibrium: ek temperature, koi khalis heat flow nahi.
